stance_basis: reviewed Section 4(f) statement for legal sufficiency and concurred with determination after review
summary: The Office of the Chief Counsel reviewed the Section 4(f) statement for the U.S. Route 30 reconstruction project for legal sufficiency, as required under DOT Order 5610.1B. The Chief Counsel's office was asked to concur with the draft Section 4(f) determination and evaluation prepared by the Environmental Programs Division. Their review contributed to the final finding that there are no feasible and prudent alternatives to the temporary use of Woodrow Wilson Woods land and that all possible planning to minimize harm was included.
complaint_summary: The Office of the Chief Counsel reviewed the Section 4(f) statement and its review contributed to the finding that there are no feasible and prudent alternatives to the use of land from Woodrow Wilson Woods and that all possible planning to minimize harm was included.
summary_quote: The Section 4(f) statement for the subject project has been reviewed by the Office of Environmental Policy and the Office of the Chief Counsel.
